paper_title: Galactic axions search with a superconducting resonant cavity
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, canonical axion-photon coupling
notes: Single-mass axion search using superconducting NbTi cavity haloscope at 9.07 GHz. Exclusion limit g_agamma < 1.03 × 10^-12 GeV^-1 at axion mass m_a ≃ 37.5 μeV (converted to 3.75 × 10^-5 eV). 95% single-sided confidence limit (1.64σ). Local DM density ρ_a = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 used in sensitivity calculation per Eq. 1. Cavity volume V = 36.43 cm^3, quality factor Q_0 = 4.5 × 10^5 at 2 T magnetic field, system noise temperature T_n = 11.0 K.
